usage_guide.title: {title}: Usage guide
usage_guide.open_html: Double-click `{html_name}` and open it in a modern browser.
usage_guide.embedded: The page logic, Leaflet runtime, styles, and business geometry are embedded in one HTML file.
usage_guide.online_basemap: Online basemaps ({basemaps}) load when a network is available; business geometry, search, filters, and layer controls continue to work offline.
usage_guide.offline: The current configuration does not require an online basemap.
usage_guide.portable: `map_spec.json` and `data/` form a portable rebuild bundle.
usage_guide.record_only: `map_spec.json` is a build record; source paths remain relative to the original specification directory, so an independent rebuild is not guaranteed.
usage_guide.inspection: `inspection.json` records input layers, field candidates, CRS, and the template recommendation.
usage_guide.report: `build_report.json` records feature counts, geometry repairs, generated IDs, warnings, and output hashes.
usage_guide.verify: Run `interactive-map-builder verify --dist <this-directory>` to verify the deliverable.

landing.page_title: Interactive Map Builder — spatial data to polished map products
landing.description: An Agent Skill that inspects spatial data, resolves restrained geometry-aware visual defaults, builds polished interactive maps, verifies them in a browser, and exports report-ready figures.
landing.eyebrow: AN AGENT SKILL FOR POLISHED MAP DELIVERY
landing.hero_title: Spatial data in. Map product out.
landing.hero_body: Turn Excel, CSV, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, and Shapefiles into searchable interactive maps, slide-ready images, and publication figures—with Atlas Studio Light visual defaults, inspection, provenance, and browser verification built in.
landing.demo_title: Two map products, not two screenshots.
landing.demo_body: Both demos are built from fixed NYC Open Data snapshots by the deterministic engine shipped in this repository.
landing.map_list_body: Search addresses, filter land-use classes and numeric fields, sort records, and inspect a selected parcel.
landing.multilayer_body: Inspect subway stations, bicycle routes, and neighborhoods with independent visibility and layer-specific search.
landing.workflow_title: Inspect, confirm, specify, build, and verify.
landing.workflow_body: The Skill resolves ambiguity, Atlas Studio Light supplies a coordinated starting point, and the Python engine owns deterministic data handling and rendering.
steps: Discover layers, geometry, CRS, field roles, and blocking issues.
Close only the information gaps the data cannot answer.
Apply geometry-aware, density-aware visual defaults while preserving explicit choices.
Create a single-file Leaflet app and static figures.
Exercise browser behavior, counts, hashes, and provenance.
